description.zh:
密码强制更新状态，取值可选范围：
- enabled：开启。
- disabled：禁用。
description.en:
The password forced update status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

description.zh: 密码初始化通知渠道列表。
description.en: The list of password initialization notification channels.

description.zh:
密码初始化配置状态，取值可选范围：
- enabled：开启。
- disabled：禁用。
description.en:
The password initialization configuration status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

description.zh:
密码初始化方式。当PasswordInitializationStatus取值为enabled时必传，取值可选范围：
- random：随机。
description.en:
The password initialization method. This parameter is required when PasswordInitializationStatus is set to enabled. Valid values:
- random: Random.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-password-initialization-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --password-initialization-status enabled --password-initialization-type random --password-forced-update-status enabled --password-initialization-notification-channels email --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetPasswordInitializationConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordInitializationType random --PasswordForcedUpdateStatus enabled --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PasswordInitializationNotificationChannels.1 email --PasswordInitializationStatus enabled --method POST --force
